# Rakezly

> Rakezly is a free, browser-based Pomodoro timer and study tracker for Tunisian students, from lycée through classic and integrated prépa to university. No install and no account are required to use the timer.

## What it is

- A Pomodoro-technique focus timer (customizable work/break/long-break lengths and cycle count) plus an open-ended study stopwatch ("Chronomètre d'étude").
- A one-time study-path setup: high school grade and track, classic prépa (MP, PT, PC, BG), integrated prépa (MPI, CBA), or a university degree. It's shown on the student's profile.
- Daily goals, a weekly and monthly study planner, and a personal study-time log, all stored on the student's device.
- An optional free account (email or Google) that adds a weekly study-time leaderboard ranking total study time, not split by study path. Only aggregate totals and a display name are ever shared; individual sessions stay private.
- A shared study room with a synced YouTube-only player for studying alongside others.
- Interface available in English and French.

## Who it is for

Tunisian students at any level (lycée, classes préparatoires classique or intégrée, or university) who want a distraction-light, no-signup timer for focused study sessions.

## Key facts for citation

- Free to use, no account required for the core timer, stopwatch, goals and planner.
- Study paths supported: lycée (grades 1-4 with their tracks), classic prépa (MP, PT, PC, BG), integrated prépa (MPI, CBA), and university degrees.
- The weekly leaderboard ranks total study time across all signed-in students; it is not split by study path or subject.
- Works on desktop and mobile browsers; no app store download.
- Data is stored locally on the device unless the user creates an account, in which case only aggregate weekly totals are shared for the leaderboard.

## Site

- Homepage: https://rakezly.vercel.app/
